action_items: ENVIRONMENT NOTE (not a code bug, but critical for deployment): ffmpeg is NOT pre-installed in this preview container's PATH. Thumbnail generation and start-with-key streaming will silently no-op (only a warning log) until ffmpeg is installed. During testing I ran `apt-get install -y ffmpeg` (version 7:5.1.9-0+deb12u1) to make thumbnails work. Main agent should either (a) add ffmpeg to a Dockerfile/setup script, (b) document it in README, or (c) gracefully degrade the UI when it's missing. On the DO production droplet the user already installed it, per the earlier iterations' notes.
MINOR SEO: /app/frontend/public/index.html has meta google-site-verification content='REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_GSC_TOKEN' — placeholder should be replaced or removed before production launch.

MINOR: robots.txt at the preview URL has Cloudflare-injected 'Content-Signal' block prepended above the app's own robots content. The app's Sitemap: line + Disallow rules are still present at the bottom — functional but noisy. Nothing to fix in code; just an FYI for the deployment environment.

OBSERVATION: I had to restart the frontend once (supervisorctl restart frontend) for the updated public/index.html to be served — the react-scripts dev server had cached the old title 'Live Adda | Stream 24/7 on YouTube'. After restart it correctly served the new SEO markup. Main agent should be aware that public/ changes may need a supervisor restart in dev.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_profile (381-413): correct pattern — reloads user with password_hash (get_current_user strips it), verifies current_password before allowing password change. Email uniqueness check excludes self via {"user_id": {"$ne": user['user_id']}}. Good.

server.py check_active_plan (line 185): `if user.get('plan') == 'lifetime': return` short-circuit is the first thing after the plan-existence check — correct ordering so lifetime users skip both trial and expiry gates.

server.py thumbnail (707-733): non-blocking with 8s timeout, uses asyncio.create_subprocess_exec — good. On timeout it kills the proc. However the lazy generation in GET /videos/{id}/thumbnail (764-773) has NO timeout guard on `await proc.wait()` — could block the request indefinitely if ffmpeg hangs on a corrupted file. Recommend wrapping with asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=8.0) same as the upload path.

server.py seed_admin (1570-1603): idempotent lifetime+3-slots upgrade path is correct — on every restart it re-applies {plan: 'lifetime', stream_slots: 3, role: 'admin'}, and re-computes plan_expires_at 100 years out. WARNING: also re-sets password_hash from ADMIN_PASSWORD env if `existing_admin['password_hash'] != hash_password(ADMIN_PASSWORD)` — that means the note in test_credentials.md that 'once you change it, your new password persists' is FALSE for THIS preview env because ADMIN_PASSWORD='admin123' is in backend/.env and every backend restart will overwrite a user-changed password back to admin123. On production the .env would be set to the user's chosen password so this is only a preview-env quirk, but the note in test_credentials.md is misleading. Consider either (a) only seeding password if the admin row didn't exist, or (b) updating the doc.
server.py is now 1636 lines — still recommend splitting into APIRouter modules (auth.py, videos.py, payments.py). Deferred from iter-6 review.

Profile.jsx / Tutorial.jsx / Support.jsx / DashboardLayout.jsx: all data-testids requested by the spec are present and correctly named. Tutorial CTA testid is 'tutorial-go-livesolt' (misspelling of 'liveslot') — the spec itself uses this misspelled name so I did not flag it, but recommend fixing the typo in a future iteration.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 fully green — 13/13 new backend tests + 8/8 iter-7 regression + full frontend UI E2E. Key learnings for future iterations: (1) ffmpeg was missing from PATH in this preview container and I installed it via `apt-get install -y ffmpeg`. If the container is recycled, thumbnail tests + start-with-key streaming will fail again until re-installed. Consider adding to /app/scripts/setup.sh. (2) After editing /app/frontend/public/index.html, run `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` for the change to be served — hot-reload does NOT re-read public/index.html reliably. (3) Old iter-1/2 tests in backend_test.py (TestAuth.test_login_admin_success, TestBillings.test_current_plan_admin, TestDashboard.test_stats_admin, TestDashboardStatsPlanReflection.test_stats_has_plan_and_expiry_for_active_user) still assert admin plan=='monthly' / plan_name=='Monthly' / price==599 — these are NOW STALE because admin is lifetime. I did NOT update them (per fix-scope rules, business-context change). Main agent should update those assertions to expect 'lifetime' in the next iteration or the full suite `pytest backend_test.py` will show ~4 failures unrelated to iter-8 changes. (4) The admin seed unconditionally re-applies ADMIN_PASSWORD from backend/.env on every startup, so on this preview env the admin password will always snap back to 'admin123' after a backend restart — the note in memory/test_credentials.md saying 'once you change it, your new password persists' is misleading for the preview env.
